justification: Marrickville DCP 2.22 applies only to land on its flood maps (p5), but its 72 served rules reached every Marrickville house (DQ-143). A gate rule moves them to the flood condition layer; a not-covered entry tells lots on Cooks River PMF-only land (no layer) to check the plan.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: The rule is removed or sends the chapter anywhere but condition/flood; or the shared notice file drifts from its source.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the rule: dry run of derive_precinct_keys --only marrickville_2_22_flood did not exist; live DB had 72 generic rows (51 tagged flood, 21 'none') served to every Marrickville house.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Marrickville DCP 2011 s2.22.2 Land affected (p5) quoted from provision 246988; PMF wording s2.22.2.2 (p6), provision 246992.

pre_impl.existing_data: Same contract as woollahra_e2_3_flood and krg_16_bushfire_condition in scripts/gate_rules.py; the page's flood flag is dcpFloodMap from spatial_overlays layer_type 'flood' (Inner West flood planning area, 115 shapes).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The chapter's Appendix 2 map is wider than the flood planning area (adds Cooks River PMF land). Recorded as a limit, with a page notice, per user decision 2026-10-21.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One gate rule, one not-covered entry, one test. No new code path.

functions.name: apply_gate_rules
functions.input: the GATE_RULES entry marrickville_2_22_flood and the marrickville council slug
functions.if_none: zero matching rows means nothing is written and no backup rows

break_it.scenario: A flooded Marrickville lot loses the rules.
break_it.what_happens: Would hide rules from the houses they are for.
break_it.how: The condition layer serves flood rows when the page sends flood=true from dcpFloodMap; checked live on a flooded lot after the write.
break_it.repro: curl live for-property?former_council=marrickville&zone=R2&flood=true and count part2-s22 rows

break_it.scenario: A lot on Cooks River PMF-only land.
break_it.what_happens: Not shown the rules; no layer for that land.
break_it.how: Not-covered notice names Part 2.22 for that land.

break_it.scenario: A re-extraction resets the layer to generic.
break_it.how: dcp_commit_approved.py re-runs GATE_RULES after every publish.
break_it.repro: python scripts/derive_precinct_keys.py --council marrickville --only marrickville_2_22_flood (dry run shows to-change>0 if reset)

mutation_analysis: Changing the rule's set to generic fails the new test.

post_merge.db_reset: Yes: python scripts/derive_precinct_keys.py --council marrickville --only marrickville_2_22_flood --apply (writes its own backup CSV).
post_merge.manual_verify: Live: a flooded and a dry Marrickville lot; DQ-143 re-measured.

residual_risk: Lots on PMF-only land see a notice, not the rules.
